description: handle_mailbox_set fetches all_mailboxes once before the create/update loop for role uniqueness checks, then re-fetches mailboxes_after_mutations for the destroy loop's child-mailbox check. If the backend does not cache this, a request with creates+destroys incurs 2 full mailbox list fetches. For accounts with many mailboxes (enterprise) this doubles the storage read cost of every Mailbox/set that both creates and destroys. The re-fetch is necessary for correctness but the pattern is not documented.
title: Mailbox/set destroy re-fetches all mailboxes after creates/updates — 2 full scans per request
